results.content:
Periscope's standalone apps shut down on March 31, 2021, so today's Periscope alternatives solve different parts of the old experience. TikTok LIVE can put a vertical broadcast in front of people who don't follow you, but hosts face age and follower requirements. Instagram Live works best when your audience already follows your account. Facebook Live remains practical for Pages, Groups, events, and local organizations. [...] What app replaced Periscope?

X is the closest official successor because Periscope's live-video function moved into X. The resemblance is strongest for public updates linked to current conversation. BIGO LIVE is closer to the old habit of browsing active hosts and joining a social room, but its culture is more entertainment-led.

 Is there an app with a global map like Periscope?

No mainstream option in this guide offers Periscope's exact zoomable globe for current streams. BIGO LIVE can surface broadcasts by country, while X can help people find live coverage through public posts and search. Both use different discovery paths. If a map is essential, verify that feature in the current app and your market before moving an audience. [...] 03

### X: The Direct Successor for Public Live Video

For anyone asking what replaced Periscope, X is the direct answer. A host opens the composer, selects the camera and Live mode, adds an optional description or location, and starts. The broadcast appears as a post in followers' timelines and on the host's profile. Public live videos and replays can travel through search, trends, shares, direct messages, notifications, and embeds.

## Glide

Glide offers unique features that make it stand out from the others. Like Periscope, it offers the user a real-time conversation with a messaging limit of about five minutes. [...] Periscope is a live-streaming app owned by Twitter. It allows users to upload and watch live videos by users and editors. It’s extremely simple to use with a vast range of channels to choose from. But are there better alternatives to Periscope? We list the top 5 alternate apps you can download to put to test.

## Facebook Live

Facebook Live is one of the latest additions to its platform. Previously, only available for users with a verified page, it’s now available to everyone. It has an added advantage that the live streaming app is built on the social networking site itself. Giving your live streams more reach for personal or business promotional activities. There’s also no need to download a separate app. You just need the Facebook app installed. [...] Highlights:

- Very easy to use interface
- You have the ability to send live video alerts to subscribers
- The live chat function is top-notch with lots of functionality
- Ability to monetize your brand
- Multi-camera support
- Unlimited event duration

## YouNow

YouNow offers a great way to show off your talents. Its widely used by gamers, musicians and artists looking to showcase their work. YouNow allows you to join broadcasters as a guest, create selfies as you stream, send gifts and chat with the community in a very interactive way. However, note that YouNow has strict measures against vulgarity, so be careful not to go against its rules.
